method: Live headed Playwright (Chromium) against local dev server (127.0.0.1:8081) on the live Supabase backend, demo org 'JA Werkt Demo Fase 1' (admin) + employee portal (Milan Kowalski). Date 2026-06-15. Plus the repo's own Playwright API-contract + public-page suite.
positive: Login + all 11 core modules (dashboard, kandidaten list+detail, vacatures, match-pipeline, uren, huisvesting, plaatsingen, facturatie, transport, whatsapp, instellingen) render with ZERO console errors; every Supabase REST call returned 200.
Error UX is plain Dutch: wrong login -> 'Ongeldige inloggegevens. Probeer het opnieuw.'; bogus public match token -> 'Deze link is ongeldig of verlopen.'; invalid onboarding token -> 'Link ongeldig'.
get_candidate_decrypted RPC works (BSN/IBAN decrypt path) - candidate detail 200.
Employee portal (PII zone: plaatsing/uren/huisvesting/auto/documenten) renders, 0 console errors, all REST 200/204.
Edge-function auth gates: API-contract suite 45/46 pass - every protected function rejects missing/invalid bearer with 401; CORS preflight 200 for public endpoints.
Console hygiene: 0 errors app-wide; only benign warnings.

issues.title: Dashboard request waterfall (~37 separate REST round-trips on load)
issues.evidence: Network capture on '/' load: ~37 sequential PostgREST GET/HEAD calls (requests 447-484). Performance risk on higher latency / larger tenants.

issues.title: Demo/production org polluted with E2E test records
issues.evidence: Many 'E2E Recruit 17797...' and 'E2E Kandidaat ...' candidates, 'E2E Funnel Woning' housing, in the live demo org. Matches open-gaps 'test-vacatures opschonen / data cleanup'. Confuses real users and demos.

issues.title: A11y: DialogContent missing aria-describedby
issues.evidence: Console warning 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}' on the welcome dialog. Likely repeated across Radix dialogs.

issues.title: PWA meta deprecation
issues.evidence: Console warning: '<meta name=apple-mobile-web-app-capable> is deprecated. Please include <meta name=mobile-web-app-capable>'. index.html PWA meta.

issues.title: React Router v7 future-flag warnings
issues.evidence: Two v6->v7 future flag warnings (startTransition, relativeSplatPath) on every page. Dev-only noise; opt-in flags recommended before a v7 upgrade.

issues.title: Employee portal writes to candidates on every load
issues.evidence: Portal dashboard load issues 2x PATCH /candidates (204) (requests 451, 460) - likely last-seen/activity tracking. Verify it cannot be abused to write unintended fields and is RLS-self-scoped.

issues.title: Stale API-contract test assertion
issues.evidence: e2e-api-contracts 'automated-messages rejects unknown job' expects 400 but gets 401 (auth checked before job validation). Correct security behavior; update the test.

issues.title: Real captured production bug: CarerixImport React Query 'enabled' not boolean
issues.evidence: Superadmin -> Foutmeldingen (client_errors): 'Expected enabled to be a boolean or a callback that returns a boolean' at /carerix-import, recurring (29-4 and 22-4) on production ja-works-hub.vercel.app. Real defect in CarerixImport useQuery enabled option.

issues.title: Real captured production bug: Radix Select.Item empty-string value crashes Housing detail
issues.evidence: client_errors: 'A <Select.Item /> must have a value prop that is not an empty string' at /huisvesting/:id (22-4) on production. Radix Select crash on a housing detail Select.

issues.title: Captured 'signal is aborted without reason' + opaque 'Script error.'
issues.evidence: client_errors: AbortController cancellation at /huisvesting (25-5) and cross-origin 'Script error.' on production (7-5). Mostly noise but the abort suggests unguarded fetch cancellation on unmount.

issues.title: Superadmin org list + demo org polluted with test orgs/records
issues.evidence: 6 orgs incl. 'E2E Full QA ...', 'QA Go Live ...', 'Test test'; demo org full of E2E candidates/housing. Cleanup before onboarding real external tenants.

positiveSuperadmin: Centralized client-error capture works (client_errors table + /superadmin/errors dashboard, 33 errors); superadmin zone gated by superadmins table + sa_* SECURITY DEFINER RPCs (200). 4th auth zone isolated and functional.
perfNotes: Dashboard ~37 REST round-trips on load; employee portal ~17; superadmin uses sa_* RPCs (2 calls). No single slow call observed but waterfall depth is the main perf risk.

recruiter_full_chain.steps: Created candidate 'QALaunch ReadyLasser' (e9e7df62): dedup pre-check fired (GET by DOB+name/email/phone before POST), POST candidates 201 + audit_log 201, post-create 'Links versturen' step. Qualified via 7-step screening call-flow (Voorbereiding..Besluit) -> Goedgekeurd; Besluit step ENFORCES a justification note for missing critical fields ('beschikbaar vanaf') before completion; status changed Nieuw -> Werkzoekend (PATCH 204). Reverse-matching 'Vacatures' tab ranked open vacancies at 63% with threshold slider + hard-block/skill/distance filters; 'Waarom?' dialog shows full transparent score breakdown in plain Dutch and does NOT disqualify on unknown availability; 'Voorstellen' created a matches row (POST 201) + audit + async AI score, Dutch toast 'Voorgesteld op vacature (AI-score wordt berekend)'.
recruiter_full_chain.notes: Screening completion fires ~5 sequential PATCH /candidates (non-atomic multi-field save). E2E test-vacancies have no required_skills so 63% is distance-driven, not skill-driven (data-quality artifact, not engine bug).

candidate_intake.steps: Opened the public profiel token link (no login) -> candidate-profile edge function GET 200, pre-filled + localized (labor-migrant language list), filled availability/rijbewijs/taal, submitted -> POST candidate-profile 200, Dutch success 'Bedankt QALaunch! Je profiel is aangevuld.'

employee_portal.steps: Logged into /portaal as Milan. Hours: entered 8u Monday -> POST timesheets 201 (Concept), submitted week -> PATCH 204, toast 'Uren ingediend', status Ingediend. Documenten renders.
employee_portal.H3_confirmed_live: CRITICAL: /portaal/ziekmelding REQUIRES a free-text 'Reden / klachten' (Beschrijf je klachten...) field - 'Ziekmelding indienen' stays disabled until filled. Per audit H3 this nature-of-illness text is auto-forwarded to the inlener (client) = AVG art.9 violation. Confirmed by form inspection (NOT submitted, to avoid firing the real client-notification cascade).

a11yRecurring: DialogContent missing aria-describedby warning recurs on multiple dialogs (welcome dialog, portal hours dialog, plaatsing dialog) - confirms QA3 is systemic across Radix dialogs.

opdrachtgever_clientportal.steps: Logged into /klantportaal as Sanne (Demo Metaalbedrijf Eindhoven). Contact-level isolation: only own company + Milan's placement visible. 'Uren doorgeven' created a timesheet (POST 201, source=klantportaal, client_approved=true, employee_confirmed=false) -> toast 'Uren doorgegeven aan medewerker', row 'Wacht op bevestiging'. Timesheet model is dual-confirmation (client gives <-> employee confirms).
opdrachtgever_clientportal.note: CLAUDE.md says client portal 'approves timesheets'; live model is actually client-gives -> employee-confirms (and employee-enters -> internal admin approves). Documentation vs behavior mismatch worth aligning.

placement_compliance_gate.steps: Advanced the QALaunch match through the full vacancy pipeline (Nieuwe match -> Gescreend -> Voorgesteld -> Bij klant -> In gesprek -> Geaccepteerd), each transition requiring a mandatory 'Feedback vastleggen' reason. 'Plaatsen' -> 'Plaatsing aanmaken' dialog (pre-filled). On confirm, the ComplianceWarningDialog 'Dossier niet compleet' BLOCKED the placement, listing 5 missing items in plain Dutch (Geen geldig ID bewijs, Contract niet getekend, Reglement niet afgetekend, BSN niet ingevuld, IBAN niet ingevuld) with an audited override 'Toch plaatsen (override) - Dit wordt gelogd als compliance override.' Did NOT override (would fire send-placement-confirmation email).
placement_compliance_gate.verdict: Compliance gating works exactly as required: blocks non-compliant placement, names every missing item in Dutch, override is explicit + audit-logged.
